title: GET /api/projects/:id/todos — list to-dos
description: Return all todos for a project ordered by sort_order, optionally filtered by milestone or completion state.
acceptanceCriteria: GET requires auth and project ownership
Returns todos ordered by sort_order ASC
Supports optional query param ?milestoneId= to filter by milestone
Returns empty array if none exist

steps.description: Implement GET / handler with optional filters
steps.details: getOwnedProject. Build query: WHERE project_id = id. If req.query.milestoneId, add AND milestone_id = milestoneId. If req.query.completed = 'true', add AND is_completed = true. ORDER BY sort_order ASC. Return 200 with array.
Create mix of completed and uncompleted todos. GET all — verify all returned. GET ?completed=true — verify only completed. GET ?milestoneId=X — verify only that milestone's todos.
